# STG Logistics Appoints Jack Holmes as Chief Executive Officer to Lead Next Phase of Growth

 October 5, 2026 

Holmes, a four-decade transportation and logistics leader, succeeds Geoff Anderman as CEO, effective immediately

Company also announces Leadership Team updates and appoints Board of Directors

COLUMBUS, Ohio, Oct. 5, 2026 — STG Logistics, Inc., one of the nation’s largest providers of integrated port-to-door services and supply chain solutions for cargo owners and logistics providers, today announced the appointment of Jack Holmes as Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately, to lead the Company into its next phase of growth. Holmes succeeds Geoff Anderman, who has held a leadership position since early 2017, including through the Company’s successful financial restructuring earlier this year. Oct 06, 2026, 10:00 ET

Dayan will lead Ascent's global operations organization as the company continues to expand its capabilities and help customers navigate increasingly complex, global time-critical supply chains.

He brings more than 26 years of logistics and supply chain experience spanning all elements of the logistics and transportation sector, in multiple geographies and markets. Most recently, Dayan served as Chief Operating Officer of Horizon Air Freight and Swift Marine, a global marine and project logistics services business. Previously, he was Head of Global Inbound Transportation at Apple, where he led procurement and operations for the company's global inbound network. ## Former UPS Freight chief takes over as STG targets growth after reducing funded debt by nearly $1 billion

 October 13, 2026 1:30 PM, EDT 

 New CEO Jack Holmes said STG’s strengthened balance sheet provides a foundation for the company’s next phase.(STG Logistics; headshot from PR Newswire) 

### Key Takeaways:

- STG Logistics named Jack Holmes CEO effective Oct. 5, succeeding Geoff Anderman after the Dublin, Ohio-based company completed a financial restructuring.
- The restructuring cut nearly $1 billion, or about 90%, of funded debt after STG exited Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection July 9.
- STG named interim finance and legal chiefs, began a permanent CFO search and retained Anderman as an adviser during the leadership transition.

STG Logistics named Jack Holmes CEO as the freight transportation company shifts its focus to growth after a financial restructuring that reduced its funded debt by nearly $1 billion. 

Holmes, whose appointment took effect Oct. 5, succeeds Geoff Anderman, who had held a leadership position at STG since early 2017 and helped guide the company through the restructuring.

# World Group Names Jess Hunger CEO, Reinforcing Family Leadership and Focus on Core Product Growth 

CLEVELAND, Ohio — World Group, the privately held, family-owned parent company of ContainerPort Group (CPG), UWL, and World Shipping announced that Jess Hunger has been named Chief Executive Officer, effective October 1. A third-generation member of the family, Jess will set World Group’s long-term strategy and direction as the company continues to focus on growing its core businesses of drayage, ocean and air transportation, customs brokerage, and vessel husbandry. 

The appointment reinforces World Group’s longstanding commitment to remaining family-owned and run and builds on the active role the third generation already plays in leading the business. For customers, this means steady leadership, decisions made for the long-term, and relationships built on personal accountability.

# Tersus Solutions Appoints Matt Williams as Company COO

October 13, 2026 SGB Update 

 

Tersus Solutions, used by a number of active lifestyle brands for their cleaning, conditioning, grading, and fulfillment resale programs, has named Matt Williams as chief operating officer (COO), effective immediately.

Williams brings more than a decade of operations leadership across the retail industry, most recently serving as COO of Raide, a Colorado-based equipment and apparel brand. Prior to Raide, Williams reportedly spent seven years at Topo Designs, the Denver-based apparel and accessories lifestyle brand, where he started as COO and later rose to lead as CEO. Before Topo Designs, Williams was vice president of operations at Exxel Outdoors and general manager at Rentokil Initial.

 AJOT Newsroom | Aug 24 2026 at 09:18 AM | Air Cargo 

ECS Group has appointed Eric St Amand as Chief Operating Officer Americas, strengthening its senior leadership team as the organization continues to expand its activities across the region.

St Amand brings more than 27 years of international experience in supply chain management, transportation and logistics. In his new position, he will lead ECS Group’s operations throughout the Americas, working closely with its regional teams, airline partners and wider commercial network to support continued growth and operational development.

His appointment forms part of ECS Group’s commitment to reinforcing its leadership structure in the Americas and ensuring that the business is positioned to respond to changing airline requirements, evolving cargo markets and new opportunities across North America, Latin America and the Caribbean.
